node: HBM-adjacent backend packaging, test, and OSAT overflow
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around the hypothesis that HBM demand is crowding backend packaging and test capacity, pushing conventional DRAM/NAND and advanced packaging overflow toward OSATs, test-equipment suppliers, probe-card/socket vendors, and semiconductor manufacturing orchestration software. Because the strongest provided evidence names Powertech as the direct case study but the mandate is US-listed companies, the US universe is treated mostly as adjacent or second-order exposure rather than proven pure-play HBM backend beneficiaries. The cleanest US-listed candidates to carry forward are Amkor as the OSAT reference, FormFactor and Cohu as test/probe/handler capacity beneficiaries, and PDF Solutions as a software/data orchestration layer for fragmented fabless-foundry-OSAT-test workflows.
